name: Dethiral
source:
"You may allude to me as an Eldritch Being, for there is no explanation for my being that you might comprehend."

Dethiral is the Mistress of Yonder World, or so you would come to understand. A literary enthusiast with a seemingly insatiable thirst for knowledge, the dark entity rules over an empty castle under a perpetual midnight.

Alluring and terrifying, Dethiral possesses undeniable charms, yet exudes an air of melancholy in the melodic timbre of her voice.

[From [url=https://flutteringabyss.itch.io/yonderworld]Itch.io[/url]]
